notes: Fixes the browser hanging on "Waiting for localhost..." while the server window shows it started normally. The server bound to 0.0.0.0, which accepts IPv4 only, but Windows resolves "localhost" to the IPv6 address ::1 first — so the browser connected to an address nothing was listening on. It now listens dual stack (IPv6 and IPv4), and the window prints http://127.0.0.1:3000 as the local address. Workaround on older versions: open http://127.0.0.1:3000 instead of localhost.
